column24: On January 2, 2022, Cultural and expo venues, sports venues, and tourist attractions are temporarily closed;  entertainment and leisure venues such as KTV, chess and card rooms, Internet cafes, and bathing centers are also temporarily closed; catering establishments are temporarily closed in Yuzhou. column51: On January 2nd, 2022, the operation of buses, taxis, online car-hailing, and trains in Yuzhou has been suspended.   Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220112153251/http://www.cneb.gov.cn/2022/01/03/ARTI1641213981227556.shtml

column24: Yuzhou City, Henan Province began to unblock the whole area on the 31st and turned to normal epidemic prevention and control. Cultural and entertainment venues and indoor crowded places continued to be closed, and other places closely related to people's lives were opened in an orderly manner  See: http://archive.today/oQg7F
column33: In Yuzhou, Henan, fairs and temple fairs need not be held, celebrating events need be postponed, and funerals need be held briefly.  See: http://archive.today/oQg7F
column42: In Yuzhou, Henan, family gatherings, dinners with friends, private gatherings, etc. are strictly limited to no more than 10 people.  See: http://archive.today/oQg7F
column60: On January 31, 2022, Yuzhou is fully unblocked. Apart from the situation that those who have not been released from home isolation in the city had to strictly follow home isolation measures, people are not required to stay at home.   See: http://archive.today/oQg7F
column69: On January 31, 2022, Yuzhou is fully unblocked. The entire city has lifted the management of the closed control area, the management control area, and the prevention area, and transferred to normalized epidemic prevention and control.  See: https://archive.ph/oQg7F

column24: From February 7, 2022, Yuzhou tourist attractions, outdoor stadiums, parks and other outdoor venues will be reopened in an orderly manner; Internet cafes, cinemas, KTV, amusement halls and other cultural and entertainment venues and religious venues, libraries, gymnasiums, science and technology museums, training institutions, bathing centers and other indoor crowded places continue to be closed. column51: From February 7, 2022, on the premise of strictly implementing various normalized epidemic prevention and control measures, public transportation in Yuzhou will resume normal traffic in an orderly manner.    See: http://archive.today/77Vtt

column24: On August 7, Qianjiang City, Hubei Province, found 1 confirmed case (ordinary type) and 4 cases of asymptomatic infection, in order to further reduce the flow of people, reduce the risk of cross-infection, and strive to achieve dynamic clearance in the shortest period of time, after the expert group researched and judged, the command decided to implement three-day temporary control measures in Garden Street, Taifeng Street, Guanghua Street, Yangshi Street and Zhouji Street in our city from 9 o'clock on August 7.    First, the residents of our city do not leave Qianjiang unless necessary during the temporary control period, and do not go out unless necessary, and advocate that personnel outside the city do not come to Qianjiang unless they need to come to Qianjiang during the temporary control period.   Secondly,Strictly control the gathering of personnel, do not hold group activities, large-scale conferences, all kinds of offline training, and suspend group activities such as literary and artistic performances and square dances. All religious activity sites are temporarily closed and all religious activities are suspended. Off-campus training institutions and tourist attractions are temporarily suspended.    Public entertainment venues (KTV, bars, script killing, escape rooms, movie theaters, chess and card rooms, mahjong halls, Internet cafes, etc.), small clinics and farmers' markets are temporarily closed. Special establishments such as colleges and universities, prisons, welfare homes, old-age care institutions, childcare institutions, and mental health establishments are to be closed and managed. column15: The Harbin Education Bureau announced that since March 14 2022, some primary and secondary schools in Harbin will switch from offline teaching to online teaching. The details are as follows. Daowai District continues to implement online teaching; Daoli District, Nangang District, Xiangfang District, Pingfang District, Songbei District, Shuangcheng District, and Wuchang City primary and secondary schools (including secondary vocational schools) will switch from offline teaching to online teaching; the remaining ten districts and counties (cities) will be assessed by the local epidemic situation headquarters and decide whether to switch between online and offline teaching in primary and secondary schools within the jurisdiction. All kindergartens in the city will be closed, and all kinds of off-campus education and training institutions will stop teaching offline. In addition, all colleges and universities within the administrative area of Harbin will implement closed management; students do not leave school or leave Harbin. The resumption of offline teaching will be announced later.    In addition, on March 15, the Heilongjiang Provincial Civil Service Bureau and the Heilongjiang Provincial Personnel Examination Center issued an announcement, deciding to postpone the 2022 written examination for civil servants in Heilongjiang Province, which was originally scheduled to be held on March 26 and 27. The restart time of the written test and related arrangements will be notified separately according to the epidemic prevention and control situation.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220316222216/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17109607  https://web.archive.org/web/20220316222231/https://t.ynet.cn/baijia/32400264.html
column24: From the Announcement No. 53 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since March 14 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    First, chess and card room (mahjong hall), bath, cinema, theater, karaoke hall, dance hall, bar, pedicure shop, massage parlor, game hall, Internet cafe, script killing, board game bar, library, escape room, indoor sports and fitness place, indoor children amusement projects, small hotels located in basements or semi-basements, various offline education and training institutions and other places with relatively closed spaces will be temporarily closed. Religious sites will be temporarily closed.     Secondly, Individual clinics will be closed. Welfare institutions, old-age service institutions, and mental health institutions implement will be under fully closed management, and personnel will be prohibited from entering and leaving. Aged care institutions will suspend the admission of newly admitted elderly people and stop visiting activities. The public security, judicial and administrative prisons will be under closed management, and family members who have direct contact will be suspended from visiting.    Thirdly, all construction sites under construction will be under closed management, and the employees of enterprises and institutions will not be allowed to leave the resident and operating sites unless necessary, and will strictly implement the "two points and one line" commuting mode.    Fourthly, various administrative enterprises and institutions at all levels will start to implement flexible working system, staggered commute to and from get off work, and actively advocate online office and home office as well. Comprehensively implement measures such as nucleic acid testing and screening, daily ventilation and disinfection, and daily health monitoring of employees.     Fifthly, all social catering service units (including food sales units that provide dine-in) will suspend dine-in, but can provide in-store pick-up and take-out ordering services; encourage the implementation of "contactless" delivery.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220316162526/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17127569

column79: On March 16 2022, the Harbin Municipal People's Government issues the "Implementation Measures for Several Financial Policies of Harbin City on Further Supporting Small, Medium and Micro-sized Enterprises and Individual Industrial and Commercial Households to Stable Production and Operation in Response to the Impact of the Epidemic", which mainly to clarify how the 2 billion funds for stabilizing and stabilizing jobs should be used. The policy mainly includes three aspects. First, implement the financial support policy for stabilizing enterprises and jobs, and encourage banks to grant loans to qualified small, medium and micro enterprises and individual industrial and commercial households through the implementation of a risk sharing mechanism for government bank guarantee institutions. The second part is to provide loan discounts to eligible enterprises. The third part is that the financing guarantee company funded by the municipal finance will reduce or exempt the guarantee fee for eligible enterprises. The scope of the financial support policy to stabilize stability and stability of jobs includes: small, medium, and micro enterprises (including individual industrial and commercial households) that have encountered difficulties in five industries, including wholesale and retail, accommodation and catering, cultural tourism, transportation and logistics, and manufacturing, which have been greatly affected by the epidemic. The loan discount policy supports: small, medium and micro enterprises and individual industrial and commercial households engaged in wholesale and retail, accommodation and catering, education, tourism, culture, sports and entertainment, transportation and other six industries in Harbin City. column24: From the Announcement No. 55 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since March 19 2022, the following policy will be implemented.     1. In addition to farmers' markets, shopping malls, supermarkets, morning markets, pharmacies, gas stations, catering enterprises (only providing self-pickup, take-out ordering services) and other basic livelihood security business places, other business places and stores should all be closed.    2. Places that are allowed to operate must strictly implement various prevention and control measures, such as "scanning code, temperature measurement, wearing masks", staggered peak current limit, daily disinfection, employee health monitoring, and employees should hold a negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours to go to work. Those who do not comply with the epidemic prevention and control regulations will be ordered to suspend business for rectification, and can resume operations only after passing the examination.    3. During the nucleic acid of all citizens in Harbin, all people entering the shopping malls, supermarkets, pharmacies, farmers markets, morning markets and other business places must hold a negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours. Those who do not have a certificate are prohibited from entering. Localities can take necessary management measures according to the actual situation.     4. Express delivery and meals takeout companies should strengthen the health management of employees. All employees should undergo nucleic acid testing once a day. In principle, express delivery and meals takeaway companies' employees are not allowed to enter the residential area, and contactless delivery methods shall be implemented. Those who need to enter the communities should use smart express cabinets, post stations, etc. to deliver express deliveries must strictly implement measures such as "scanning code, temperature measurement, wearing masks", piece-by-piece disinfection, and strictly inspect delivery personnel for 24 hours Negative certificate of nucleic acid test.    5. During the nucleic acid testing of all citizens, all levels of government agencies, enterprises and institutions in Harbin shall strictly manage all entry and exit channels, strictly implement measures such as "scanning codes, measuring temperature, and wearing masks" for all entry personnel, and conduct inspections for 48 hours negative certificate of COVID-19 nucleic acid testing.    6. The business of various types of administrative examination and approval service halls, petition reception places and other window units in our city can be handled online or by self-service, all of which are handled in a "non-face-to-face" manner. And implement various epidemic prevention and control measures.    7. All kinds of enterprises should take the main responsibility for epidemic prevention and control, and strictly implement the "two points and one line" commuting mode.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220323133745/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17203544

column24: From the Announcement No. 57 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since April 1 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    1. The agricultural business activities will be orderly resumed. The agricultural businesses, distribution and maintenance of agricultural machineries, accessories and other business places and stores in the Harbin city will resume operation in an orderly manner. Various prevention and control measures such as peak staggering and current limiting, daily disinfection and employee health monitoring shall be strictly implemented. In addition, strictly implement the prevention and control measures such as "code scanning (health code + travel code), temperature measurement, wearing masks" and checking the negative certificate of nucleic acid test within 48 hours.    2. Carry out agricultural agency services in an orderly manner. For the residents in the sealed and controlled areas and the farmers who are carrying out medical observation and health monitoring, all townships and villages shall uniformly organize the purchase, collection, storage, custody and farming services of agricultural materials.    3. The auto repair operations will be resumed. The auto repair stores that meet the epidemic prevention and control standards in the Harbin city will resume operation in an orderly manner, and an appointment system will be implemented. Also, strictly implement various prevention and control measures such as peak staggering and current limiting, daily disinfection and employee health monitoring. In addition, strictly implement "code scanning (health code + travel code), temperature measurement and wearing masks" for all entrants, and check the negative certificate of nucleic acid test within 48 hours. The number of instantaneous customers shall not exceed the total number of maintenance stations.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: http://web.archive.org/web/20220407095623/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17432242
column69: From the Announcement No. 57 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since April 1 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    1. The Harbin city will liberalize travel restrictions on agricultural production in an orderly manner. All kinds of new agricultural entities and farmers in epidemic free villages and towns implement the "two points and one line" operation mode, and there are no restrictions on their operation and travel within their jurisdiction. For cross Township operations, report to the village where the operation is located in advance, and disinfect the agricultural machinery when entering and leaving. Personnel shall hold the negative certificate of nucleic acid test within 48 hours, and shall not take public transport for "point-to-point" operation. Farmers living in cities and towns must return home in an orderly manner with a negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours to carry out agricultural activities, and those who are undergoing medical observation and health monitoring will be postponed to return home. Personnel from epidemic areas outside the administrative area of Harbin are prohibited from coming to Kazakhstan to carry out agricultural production and work activities.    2. The orderly and smooth the green channel of agricultural materials transportation will be implemented. Cross regional "point-to-point" transportation is allowed for vehicles transporting agricultural means of production and agricultural machines and tools. The drivers and passengers shall be managed in a closed manner throughout the whole process, and unloading and handover shall be conducted without contact. Among them, the transport vehicles from the districts in the Harbin city can be delivered to the designated place of the village for contactless delivery. For transport vehicles from outside the districts in the Harbin city, the receiving unit shall report to the district’s headquarters in advance. Also, implement "landing detection" for drivers and passengers (if the "landing detection" has been carried out at the entry checkpoint, the detection will not be repeated). The vehicles shall be disinfected and escorted by special personnel to the designated place for contactless delivery. During the period, standardized personal protection shall be done.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: http://web.archive.org/web/20220407095623/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17432242

column24: From the Announcement No.14 of Hegang City's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since April 4 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    1. All kinds of farmers' markets, morning markets, shopping malls, supermarkets, grocery stores, fruit and vegetable stores and other places in the city can be opened in an orderly manner after passing the inspection and evaluation by the territorial and competent industrial departments. And strengthen management. All places should strictly implement code scanning, wearing masks and other prevention and control measures, and obey the management and guidance of managers. The masses shall leave in time after purchasing, and shall not gather to stay.    2. Medical institutions at all levels shall implement closed management and prohibit visits. The private clinic was closed. The drugstore resumed business. The "four types" of drugs such as fever and cough strictly implemented the "filling and reporting", timely pushed the information to the local community for follow-up, and implemented closed-loop management.    3. Express delivery, takeout and other enterprises should further strengthen the implementation of main responsibilities and strengthen the health management of employees. All personnel shall conduct nucleic acid test once a day.    4. Catering service units shall be opened in an orderly manner after passing the inspection and evaluation by the local competent department. We should strictly implement the main responsibility for epidemic prevention and control, do a good job in health monitoring of employees, and ensure food and personnel safety. Advocate the provision of self-service and takeout delivery services. Indoor dining shall be limited by 50% of the approved number of people, with less than 6 people per table and dining at separate tables in the hall.    5. Barber shops can be opened orderly after passing the inspection and evaluation by the local competent department. 50% flow restriction and reservation system shall be implemented, and there shall be no customers waiting in the store. Staff and customers should wear masks throughout the process. Strictly implement code scanning, temperature measurement, ventilation, killing and other prevention and control measures to achieve "one customer, one use and one disinfection".    6. The construction site under construction shall be subject to closed management. Employees of enterprises and institutions who live in centralized accommodation shall not leave the site and operation place unless necessary, and the "two points and one line" commuting mode shall be strictly implemented. Strengthen personnel health monitoring and nucleic acid detection.    7. Party and government organs, enterprises and institutions in the city resumed normal office order. The affiliated units shall compact the main responsibility and implement epidemic prevention measures such as ventilation and killing. Supervise and urge the cadres and workers of the unit to strictly abide by the provisions on epidemic prevention and implement the requirements of "five leading" and "three trying". Strengthen personal protection and advocate the "two points and one line" commuting mode.    8. Chess and card room (mahjong Hall), bathing, cinema, concert hall, dance hall, billiards hall, bar, foot therapy shop, massage parlor, game hall, Internet cafe, script killing, board game bar, library, secret room escape, small theater, health salon, tea house, coffee shop, milk tea shop, ball hall, gym, swimming pool and other indoor leisure, fitness and entertainment places, indoor children's amusement projects, beauty salons, various offline education and training institutions Health products conference marketing training points, health lecture publicity points, various health care equipment experience stores and other places with relatively closed space will be suspended, and the opening hours will be notified separately.    See Guangming Net website.    Archived:  http://web.archive.org/web/20220408213823/https://m.gmw.cn/baijia/2022-04/04/1302881964.html
column33: From the Announcement No.14 of Hegang City's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since April 4 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    1. column24: From the Announcement No. 58 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since April 11 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    1. Harbin city's daily consumer goods wholesale and retail markets, commercial complexes, department stores, bookstores, libraries, museums, science and technology museums, cultural centers, art galleries and other places and non-productive business activities such as consulting services, insurance agents, and legal services are orderly resume business. Items such as dine-in restaurants, games and entertainment, beauty and fitness, training institutions, and theaters in the venues will be temporarily resumed. Business sites must strictly implement various prevention and control measures such as peak shift and current limit, one-meter noodles, daily disinfection, and employee health monitoring. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours. The number of customers received shall not exceed 50% of the full capacity.    2. Harbin city's barber shops resume business in an orderly manner. However, it is necessary to strictly implement "scanning code (health code + travel code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours. Reservations are made in strict accordance with the number of seats, and no customers are allowed to wait in the store. Strictly implement the system of "one customer, one exchange and one disinfection" for hairdressing supplies and appliances and environmental cleaning and disinfection. Staff and customers wear masks at all times.    3. Municipal, district (city) organs and institutions resume flexible office work, and strictly implement the "two points and one line" commuting mode. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours.    4. Various administrative examination and approval service halls, petition reception places and other window units will resume on-site business processing in an orderly manner. However, it is necessary to strictly implement "scanning code (health code + travel code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours. The number of guests should not exceed 50% of the full capacity. Enterprises and the masses are encouraged to conduct business through non-direct contact methods such as online and self-service. Actively advocate the appointment of urgent matters and postpone the handling of non-urgent matters.    5. Harbin city's water, electricity, gas and communications and other public institutions resume offline payment in an orderly manner. However, it is necessary to strictly implement various prevention and control measures such as peak shifting and current limiting, daily disinfection, and employee health monitoring. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours. The number of people who pay for reception shall not exceed 50% of the full number of receptionists.    6. Acheng District, Bayan County, Bin County, Yanshou County, Mulan County, Tonghe County, and Fangzheng County will resume dine-in in an orderly manner, but strictly implement various prevention and control measures such as staggered peak flow, daily disinfection, and employee health monitoring The measures are to strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing a mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours, and the number of consumers to receive shall not exceed 50% of the approved seats. The resumption of dine-in meals in Shuangcheng District, Wuchang City, Shangzhi City, and Yilan County shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant regulations of the local headquarters.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220419231905/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17559657

column15: From the Announcement the Harbin Education Bureau, since April 12 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    The Harbin Education Bureau issues the "Notice on the Resumption of Offline Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools and Kindergartens in Pingfang District" on the 11th. According to the Announcement No. 58 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter and the relevant requirements of the Municipal Education Bureau for the safe and orderly resumption of offline teaching, primary and secondary schools and kindergartens in the district will resume offline teaching in stages and in batches. The following are notices of admission time and relevant requirements.    Schedule:  On April 12, the graduating grade of junior high school and high school (including secondary vocational school) will resume school;  On April 14, non-graduating grades of junior high school and high school (including secondary vocational school) will resume school;  Primary schools and kindergartens will resume on April 18.    Related requirements:  1. Before returning to the school (garden), all faculty, staff, students, young children and co-residents must submit a screenshot of the nucleic acid test within 48 hours, and the result will be negative before returning to the school (garden).  2. Teachers, students and employees who currently live in medium and high risk areas are not allowed to return to the campus (garden).  3. Students who are still undergoing centralized isolation, home isolation and home health monitoring continue to teach online and are not allowed to return to school (garden). After the control and control are lifted, they can only return to the school (garden) with relevant lifting materials (certificates).  4. Teachers, students and employees living in the closed and controlled areas are not allowed to return to the school (garden). After the closure and control are lifted, the school (garden) can only be operated with relevant lifting materials (certificates).    See The Paper news website.    Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220419232607/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17561547

Commercial complexes, department stores, daily consumer wholesale and retail markets, building decoration materials markets, and automobile and spare parts business, consulting services, insurance agents, and legal service venues will resume in an orderly manner under the premise of strictly implementing epidemic prevention and control measures. operate. To be equipped with video surveillance equipment and ensure normal operation. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, and wearing a mask" for all entering personnel. Strictly check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 72 hours. The number of customers in an indoor closed place shall not exceed 50% of the full number of customers. The number of customers in outdoor venues shall not exceed 75% of the full capacity.    4. Individual clinics resume normal business in an orderly manner. It is necessary to strictly implement various prevention and control systems such as pre-examination and triage, epidemiological history investigation, and contact history verification. It is forbidden to admit and treat febrile patients and provide door-to-door diagnosis and treatment services for febrile patients. Patients with fever should be reported promptly.    5. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours. Non-local personnel and vehicles are not allowed to enter unless necessary. Those who really need to enter must strictly follow the registration and approval procedures.    6. Municipal, district/county (city) organs and institutions resume normal office work in an orderly manner. It is necessary to strictly implement the "two points and one line" commuting mode. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 72 hours. Persons outside the agency are not allowed to enter the agency's work area unless necessary. Those who really need to enter due to participating in meetings, reporting work, etc., must strictly perform the registration approval process, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 72 hours.    7. Public security, judicial and administrative prisons continue to implement closed management. Continue to suspend direct contact visitation.    See The Paper news website. column79: At the press conference on "relevant information on policies and measures for financial assistance to enterprises in Heilongjiang Province" held by the Information Office of the people's Government of Heilongjiang Province, since June 2nd 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    Affected by the epidemic, the production and operation of some profit-making enterprises in Heilongjiang Province fell into difficulties or even stopped. At the same time, personal mortgage customers have difficulties in repayment. On June 2, LiuXiaoHui, deputy director of Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau, said that Heilongjiang banking and insurance regulatory bureau had implemented the policy requirements of the CBRC at the press conference on "relevant information on policies and measures for financial assistance to enterprises in Heilongjiang Province" held by the Information Office of Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government. Implement the policy of delaying the repayment of principal and interest for the groups affected by the epidemic. Ensure continuous loan and no pressure on loan.    LiuXiaoHui said that for small, medium-sized and micro enterprises (including owners of small, medium-sized and micro enterprises), individual industrial and commercial households, truck drivers and other production and operation entities, Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau has made great efforts to extend their loans as long as possible, so as to ensure the employment of market entities.    For those who have been hospitalized or isolated due to infection with COVID-19 and have lost their source of income due to the impact of the epidemic, Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau has flexibly adjusted the repayment plan for their existing personal housing, consumption and other loans and exempted them from penalty interest. Especially since the beginning of this year, in view of the repeated epidemic situation in the whole province, the pressure on epidemic prevention and control has increased, and some residents have difficulties in repaying their mortgage loans. In April, Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau issued the notice on doing a good job in mortgage loan relief for customers affected by the epidemic, requiring banking financial institutions within their jurisdiction to make every effort to do a good job in mortgage loan relief for residents affected by the epidemic.    First, accurate portraits. Banking financial institutions should attach great importance to it, strengthen their organizational leadership, implement their work responsibilities and improve their working mechanisms. Accurately identify customers' conditions, enrich handling channels and optimize handling processes.    The second is to make rational use of rescue methods. Financial institutions in the banking sector have taken such relief measures as flexibly adjusting mortgage loan repayment arrangements, reasonably delaying the repayment period, protecting the relevant rights and interests of the public in credit investigation, and other legally compliant and risk controllable support methods. Further enrich financial service measures to effectively alleviate the repayment pressure of customers.    Third, increase policy publicity. Banking financial institutions publicize policies through websites, apps, outlets and other forms.    Fourth, provide follow-up services. Banking institutions should strengthen communication and explain the repayment to customers after the change. Show the repayment plan in detail, and effectively protect the customer's right to know. Make timely feedback on relevant consultation and complaint information.    See People's Daily Online website. column69: From the latest regulations of travel to and from Harbin published on August 2nd, the following policies will be implemented. This announcement will come into force on the date of issuance.    1. Each station in Harbin  Arriving at the station: All passengers departing from Kazakhstan will only check the Longjiang health code, not the nucleic acid report.  Outbound:  (1) Passengers arriving in Kazakhstan (non-port cities) will only check the Longjiang health code when they leave the station, not the nucleic acid report.  (2) When passengers from outside the province and port cities within the province arrive and leave the station, they will still verify the 48-hour nucleic acid report (either electronic or paper version) and on-the-spot nucleic acid testing.    2. Airport  Come to Harbin:  (1) For all returnees to Kazakhstan, the nucleic acid test report within 48 hours of landing inspection (paper, electronic, screenshot, mixed inspection, and single inspection are all acceptable)  (2) With the code scanning and temperature measurement, you can leave normally if the green code and the temperature are normal.  (3) Actively report to the community and implement other epidemic prevention policies  (4) If you want to travel to Kazakhstan, you need to report to the hotel where you live or the community where the hotel is located.    From Harbin:  Harbin Airport will no longer check the nucleic acid test report, but it is necessary to consult the airline's epidemic prevention requirements in advance. Passengers going to Beijing need to check whether Beijing Healthbao has a green code in advance. If there is an abnormality, they cannot go.    3. High-speed epidemic control situation  (1) Harbin Ring Expressway:  Harbin East Station exit control (returning to Harbin truck personnel report to the area or freight yard they are going to in advance, and do a free nucleic acid test within 24 hours, and free nucleic acid + antigen test in medium and high-risk areas)  (2) Hatong Expressway:  Tongjiang station exit control (inspection at the epidemic prevention card point, personnel entering Tongjiang need to hold a nucleic acid test report within 48 hours and landing nucleic acid test) Tongjiang station entrance control (epidemic prevention card point, scan double code, temperature measurement, registration, all vehicles need Negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours)    4. Harbin quarantine control measures    (1) If one or more cases of local positive infection are reported in China, if the risk area of ??the epidemic has not been adjusted, and it is not clear whether there is a risk of community transmission and spillover, the county (city, district, banner) where the case was reported will travel and live within 7 days Personnel from history and returnees will immediately conduct investigations, establish risk personnel management files, and implement 3-day 2-inspection measures for personnel management and control measures in counties (cities, districts, and flags) where the medium and high-risk areas are located.  (2) For those who have a history of living in high-risk areas within 7 days, take 7-day centralized isolation medical observation, carry out nucleic acid testing on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 7th days of centralized isolation, and the management period starts from leaving the risk area. rise.  (3) For those who have lived in medium-risk areas within 7 days, take 7-day home isolation medical observation, and conduct a nucleic acid test on the 1st, 4th, and 7th days of home isolation medical observation. If you do not have the conditions for home isolation medical observation, centralized isolation medical observation is adopted; the management period starts from leaving the risk area.  (4) For those who live in low-risk areas within 7 days, complete two nucleic acid tests within 3 days (sampling interval is 24 hours), and conduct health monitoring.  (5) For those who have a history of living in other counties (cities, districts, banners) in the cities (or municipalities directly under the Central Government) where the medium and high risk areas are located within 7 days, a free nucleic acid test shall be conducted as soon as possible within 24 hours after arriving at the destination.  (6) Persons with a history of living in low, medium or high-risk areas within 7 days, or those who have not adjusted the local risk area, but who have returned from the county (city, district, banner) where the local epidemic occurred, must report to the locality 2 days before arrival. Community (village) and unit reports (such as temporary return trips to be reported in advance as soon as possible). Report to the local community (village) and unit (or hotel) as soon as possible and no more than 12 hours after arrival, and the local epidemic prevention and control command department will implement the control measures at different levels. Persons with a history of sojourn and residence in low-risk areas refer to persons with a history of sojourn and residence in counties (city district flags) of cities (or municipalities directly under the Central Government) where medium- and high-risk areas are located. Asymptomatic infected persons and mild cases who meet the conditions for home isolation and do not have serious underlying diseases are generally subject to home isolation, or they can voluntarily choose centralized isolation for treatment. Strengthen health monitoring during the isolation period. On the 6th and 7th day of isolation, two consecutive nucleic acid tests with a Ct value = 35 will be released from isolation. If the condition worsens, transfer to a designated hospital for treatment in time.    2. Close contacts who are eligible for home isolation are subject to home isolation for 5 days, or they can voluntarily choose centralized isolation. After the nucleic acid test was negative on the fifth day, the isolation was lifted. For close contacts who are currently in centralized isolation and meet the conditions for home isolation, they can return to their place of residence in a "point-to-point" closed loop, and implement follow-up home isolation medical observation.    3. People in home isolation should live alone or in a single room. Try to use a separate bathroom and take personal protection. Minimize contact with other family members. During the period of home isolation, I and my co-residents are not allowed to go out.    4. For positive infections, medical observers in centralized or home isolation, and co-residents, the Longjiang Health Code will be assigned a "red code" for management. Timely decoding of medical observations for cure or release of isolation, other personnel will no longer be assigned codes for management.    5. High-risk areas are defined by buildings, units, floors, and households, and shall not be expanded to areas such as residential areas, communities, and streets (townships) at will. All forms of temporary blockade shall not be adopted. If there is no risk of community transmission, high-risk areas may not be designated.    6. After the high-risk areas are demarcated, the community must immediately inform the residents of the isolation and control time. Nucleic acid tests were performed on the fifth day of isolation for personnel in high-risk areas, and the quarantine was released in time after the results were negative. In case of secondary cases, only the residents with secondary positive cases shall be controlled, and the control time of other personnel shall not be extended.    7. It is strictly forbidden to block fire exits, unit doors, and community doors in various ways. Ensure that the channels for people to go out to see a doctor, seek medical treatment, and avoid danger are unobstructed.    See The Paper news website. (2) Promptly and accurately determine close contacts, and no longer determine close contacts.    (3) Adjust the "7-day centralized isolation" to "7-day home isolation" for spillover personnel in high-risk areas, during which code management is assigned and must not go out. Nucleic acid tests were carried out on the 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 7th days of home isolation.    (4) Adjust the risk area from "high, medium, and low" to "high and low" to minimize control personnel. In principle, areas such as the place of residence of infected persons and work places and activity places with frequent activities and high risk of epidemic transmission are designated as high-risk areas, and high-risk areas are generally delimited by units and buildings, and must not be arbitrarily expanded; Other areas of the county (city, district, banner) where the high-risk area is located are designated as low-risk areas. column69: On June 8, the office of the leading group for the prevention and control of novel coronavirus pneumonia in Zhejiang Province issued the notice on scientifically and accurately adjusting the health management measures for Shanghai personnel who came to and returned to Zhejiang.  The "7-day centralized isolation medical observation +7-day home health observation" will be implemented for the township (street) where the middle and high-risk areas in Shanghai are located or the township (street) who have local social face positive cases in 7 days. During the home health observation, nucleic acid detection was performed once on the 2nd and 7th day respectively.  The "7-day routine health monitoring" will be implemented for those who come to Zhejiang and return to Zhejiang from the districts where the middle and high-risk areas in Shanghai are located or where there are local social face positive cases within 7 days. During daily health monitoring, nucleic acid detection shall be carried out once in the first, second, third and seventh days respectively, and the requirements for local normalized nucleic acid detection shall be met.  "7-day routine health monitoring" was carried out for the personnel from other regions in Shanghai who came to and returned to Zhejiang. During daily health monitoring, nucleic acid detection shall be carried out once in the first and seventh days respectively, and the requirements for local normalized nucleic acid detection shall be met.  During the daily health monitoring, the above personnel are required to control the scope of activities, do not take public transport, do not participate in gatherings such as conferences, exhibitions, tourism and dinners, do not enter schools, nurseries, nursing homes, welfare homes and other specific institutions, do not enter indoor closed places such as cinemas, dance halls, bathrooms and Internet cafes, do not carry out offline teaching, training and other activities, and must wear masks in the whole process when going out, Keep a safe social distance, and in principle, do not leave the county (city, district) before ending the daily health monitoring.    http://archive.today/2022.06.08-125704/https://m.gmw.cn/2022-06/08/content_1302987248.htm

column15: Since 0:00 on August 11, Yiwu has implemented silent management. The whole city (except Dachen, Chian and high-risk areas) is controlled by reference to the medium risk area (control area standard). Among them, the high-risk area (sealed area) implements the "door-to-door service without leaving the house", the living materials are distributed to the households, and the nucleic acid sampling is carried out at the door. In other areas, the policy of "not leaving the area" is implemented. The living materials are delivered to the point, the wrong time is taken and the nucleic acid sampling is carried out. The mask is worn throughout the whole process. It is strictly prohibited to gather. 1. Strictly control public places. All public places in Yiwu, except medical institutions and basic livelihood guarantee units, have been suspended. 2. Industrial and key logistics enterprises have conditions to start construction. Some industrial and key logistics enterprises that meet the closed-loop management conditions are allowed to carry out closed-loop production and operation, and other industrial and commercial enterprises are allowed to suspend production and operation activities. 3. Strict management of special institutions. Schools and off campus educational and training institutions suspend offline teaching; Nursing homes, children's welfare homes, places of religious activities, etc. are temporarily closed; The administrative service center implements online office. 4. Strict inspection and control of intercity traffic checkpoints. In principle, other vehicles can not enter or leave Yiwu except those that guarantee life, production and anti epidemic. 5. Gathering activities are strictly prohibited. All gatherings such as exhibitions, promotions and square dances will be suspended. Family and friends are strictly forbidden to get together for dinner. https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Ijs9_NFgB5NpVqtwFSoeVg  http://archive.today/2022.08.24-152809/https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Ijs9_NFgB5NpVqtwFSoeVg

column24: Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, issued a notice on August 16. From now on, all counties (cities and districts) with local positive infection will suspend business for 3 days for bars, KTVs, screenplays, cinemas, Internet cafes, gyms, chess and card rooms, bathing places and other closed space entertainment places in the relevant areas. Strictly control aggregate activities. The number and scale of activities shall be strictly controlled in accordance with the principle of "no non critical activities, no online activities and no offline activities". The organizers of meetings and activities with more than 50 people need to formulate epidemic prevention and control plans and strictly implement various prevention and control measures. In principle, large-scale conferences, exhibitions, cultural activities, sports events and other crowd gathering activities with more than 200 people will be temporarily suspended.   http://archive.today/2022.08.24-152940/https://news.sina.com.cn/c/2022-08-16/doc-imizirav8399125.shtml%23/

column15: The COVID-19 epidemic prevention and control headquarters of Yiwu City decided to remove some quiet management areas from 0:00 on August 18, 2022. Farmers' markets, supermarkets, convenience stores, barbers' shops, laundries and other livelihood service places will be restored in an orderly manner. Farmers' markets and supermarkets will be opened to the public at 30% of their capacity. All catering establishments will continue to suspend in-house food, and only provide self-service and take out service. Each business entity shall strictly implement the responsibility of epidemic prevention and control, strictly prevent personnel from gathering, urge the admission personnel to wear masks, scan the site code, check the health code, travel card and nucleic acid negative certificate within 24 hours. Closed places such as chess and card room, bathing (shower), foot massage shop, KTV, bar, Internet bar and game hall will continue to be closed; Training institutions and kindergartens continue to suspend offline teaching; Pension service institutions, welfare institutions and rescue management institutions continue to implement closed management. All kinds of religious sites continue to implement the "double suspension" (suspending the opening of sites and all collective religious activities). Strictly control all kinds of meetings and activities, and temporarily do not hold large-scale conferences, forums, exhibitions, wedding banquets, night markets and other gathering activities. We advocate that weddings should be postponed, funerals should be simplified, and banquets should not be held.  http://archive.today/2022.08.24-152737/https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20220817A0AGGE00.html

A: In order to support the epidemic prevention and control work, the state has issued the following preferential personal income tax policies:  First, the temporary work subsidies and bonuses obtained by medical staff and epidemic prevention workers participating in the epidemic prevention and control work in accordance with the standards stipulated by the government are exempt from personal income tax. Temporary work subsidies and bonuses for personnel involved in epidemic prevention and control stipulated by the provincial and above provincial governments shall be implemented mutatis mutandis.  Second, the medicines, medical supplies and protective supplies (excluding cash) issued by the unit to individuals for the prevention of new coronary pneumonia are not included in wages and salaries, and are exempt from personal income tax. column77: What personal income tax preferential policies have been introduced to support epidemic prevention and control?    A: In order to support the epidemic prevention and control work, the state has issued the following preferential personal income tax policies:  First, the temporary work subsidies and bonuses obtained by medical staff and epidemic prevention workers participating in the epidemic prevention and control work in accordance with the standards stipulated by the government are exempt from personal income tax. The standards stipulated by the government include the subsidy and bonus standards stipulated by governments at all levels.  Temporary work subsidies and bonuses for personnel involved in epidemic prevention and control stipulated by the provincial and above provincial governments shall be implemented mutatis mutandis.  Second, the medicines, medical supplies and protective supplies (excluding cash) issued by the unit to individuals for the prevention of new coronary pneumonia are not included in wages and salaries, and are exempt from personal income tax.  The above policies will be implemented from January 1, 2020, and the deadline will be announced separately depending on the epidemic situation.      Archived link:  https://archive.ph/y5Mpl

column15: Updated on 17 Dec 2022,    In a statement posted on the Chinese social media site WeChat on Saturday, Shanghai's education bureau announced that most year groups in primary and secondary schools would move to online learning from Monday.    Students and children who do not have alternative childcare arrangements can apply to attend school.    The statement said the measures were being put in place in order to protect the health of teachers and students in line with current coronavirus prevention measures.    The decision means that schools in the country's financial hub will be closed for in-person learning until the end of term on 17 January, when the Lunar New Year holiday starts.    Some Chinese social media users praised the decision, agreeing that it was best that students stay at home. Others complained about the efficacy of online learning in relation to in-person teaching and the extra strains put on working parents.    https://archive.vn/Q6wBV  https://archive.vn/EqlcS
column24: Yinchuan, Ningxia province implements classified COVID-19 management after three-day static management: Starting from October 17, 2022, Yinchuan shall implement different COVID-19 control measures based on the risk level of specific areas. Residents in the low-risk areas can go to work by holding a workplace paper certificate with the required info and promising they will only travel between home and workplace without visiting other places. They are required not to gather, not to eat together, and not to take public transportation. People who need to travel across the city have to hold a negative nucleic acid test certificate from the last 48 hours.    Many office workers have begun to work from home but some factories are becoming thinly staffed as workers call in sick. Business owners and executives said this was causing increasing disruption to production and supply chains.    The boss of a printed circuit board factory in the eastern province of Shandong said only 20 per cent of staff came to work on Friday, the rest calling in sick with Covid. “One after another tested positive. I’m worried that I will have to shut the factory down,” they said.    https://web.archive.org/web/20230111221837/https://www.china-briefing.com/news/china-coronavirus-updates-latest-developments-business-advisory-part-2/  https://web.archive.org/web/20230111222027/https://www.ft.com/content/598c81b7-bbc7-40f2-ba04-eed0dddfb989
